estimand_amendment.rationale: The trichotomous encoding discards excursion magnitude and inflates the session-level SD to 26.91 ticks, requiring 10443 sessions for MDE 1. The magnitude estimand is the one the GC sibling instrument already runs, with a measured session-level SD of 11.53 ticks.

n_rand_matching_definitions.availability: Event-level flag: the forward window of the maximum horizon (250 observations) fits completely within the event's CME session, making the event evaluable in all 16 cells. Aligned with incomplete_path_policy=EXCLUDE_WITH_REASON: N_RAND anchors are drawn from the same pool of fully evaluable positions as K_ABS.
n_rand_matching_definitions.coarse_phase: Chicago-time 4-hour block from the 17:00 session open: phase = floor(chicago_minutes_since_17:00 / 240) within the CME session, 6 phases (with ~23h of trading, 17:00 to 16:00 next day, the last phase covers 3h). Deliberate coarsening of GC's chicago_30_minute_bin for stratum capacity: with ~652 events/session in NQ, 30-minute bins crossed with volatility bins would leave ~1.8 events/stratum/session, too sparse for without-replacement N_RAND sampling; 4-hour blocks leave ~109 events/phase/session at the median before crossing.

corrigendum.issue: The signed text literally said '2-hour blocks, 6 phases', but 2h x 6 = 12h does not cover a ~23h CME trading session, and the other two signed figures (6 phases, ~109 events/phase/session at ~652 events/session) are mutually consistent only with 4-hour blocks (652/6 = 108.7; 652/12 = 54.3).
corrigendum.ratification_channel: Notion AI survey, recorded in docs/DECISIONES_NICO_2026-08-30.md (D6 corrigendum)
corrigendum.resolution: Corrected to 4-hour blocks per the self-consistent signed figures. Found by Claude (canal entry 012), confirmed by independent auditor recomputation (canal entry 013), ratified by Nico.

n_rand_matching_definitions.local_volatility_bin: Per-contract quintile of pre-anchor local volatility: median absolute tick delta over the 500 ticks strictly preceding the event; quintile edges computed over all pre-holdout events of the contract. Events with fewer than 500 prior ticks in the session fall into their own visible stratum INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY, never a silent exclusion.
n_rand_matching_definitions.signature_channel: Notion AI survey, recorded in docs/DECISIONES_NICO_2026-08-30.md (D6)
n_rand_matching_definitions.target_free_note: availability and local_volatility_bin are computed from the session registry and strictly pre-anchor ticks on Kaggle; nothing post-event is touched, so this adds no outcome access.

power_design.icc_retired_reason: Within-session pairing cancels the shared session effect, so the session-level SD already embeds clustering. The GC bootstrap CI95 for ICC was [0.0254, 0.5317], too wide to use, and the fail-closed upper bound was worse than the previously assumed 0.20.

mde_reconciliation.problem: 2.861 is the exact MDE@234, so ceil() of the required-session formula returns 235, one more than the 234 available. The authorized value is not implementable as written.
mde_reconciliation.why_conservative: A larger MDE is a weaker claim, so adopting 2.90 cannot inflate sensitivity. It stays below 3.360, the lower bound of the GC CI95, which is the condition that matters for being powered against an effect of the size the sibling instrument measures.

upper_bound_reasons: NQ cell barriers 5-30 ticks and horizons 25-250 obs cap variation more tightly than GC tick_cap=2000 / clock_cap_seconds=900
NQ has 652.54 events per session versus 72.39 in GC, reducing the sampling component
